notes: This repo is both a product (simplicio-mapper itself) and the starter template it ships (see bin/cli.js TEMPLATE_PATHS).
template_root_paths mirrors bin/cli.js TEMPLATE_PATHS: the payload copied byte-for-byte into host projects by the bootstrap.
product_paths is the subset that also carries this product's OWN filled-in, real content (used as a worked example for INIT.md to refine on the host).
generic_placeholder_paths is the subset whose stated purpose is to remain a fill-in-the-blanks scaffold for any host — never a drift finding.
known_gaps lists product_paths-shaped files that are NOT yet filled in for this product itself (still carry <PLACEHOLDER> tokens) — legitimate drift findings, not exemptions.
